study type: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
outcome: death in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
death at <15 months corrected gestational age
cohort: The study included 458 preterm infants with noncephalic presentation at delivery and 1,485 infants with cephalic presentation.
finding: Noncephalic presentation at delivery was associated with an increased risk of death in the NICU or death at <15 months corrected gestational age, and a decreased risk of IVH.
mod_finding: The risk of death at <15 months corrected gestational age was increased in noncephalic neonates born via cesarean delivery and in the vaginal delivery group.
